decisions.statement: Every account and category and tag and merchant and holding and transaction lands on a full run.
Our copy is reported against Monarch's own totals once the landing is done.
The category rules are run over the rows that arrived.
The full pass repairs the rows the minutely poll left alone.
A run told to be incremental lands the trusted window rather than the whole of Monarch.
A failing account is caught and named rather than stopping the rest.
Every account is tried before the run ends.
A run in which any account failed ends non-zero.

definition: the whole of Monarch copied and the copy compared against it
